The '''2023–24 season''' was [[Al Nassr FC|Al-Nassr]]'s 48th consecutive season in the top flight of [[Football in Saudi Arabia|Saudi football]] and 68th year in existence as a [[Football club (association football)|football club]].<ref>{{cite web |title=عن النادي |url=https://alnassr.sa/ar/about |access-date=3 June 2023 |archive-date=10 June 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220610063706/https://alnassr.sa/ar/about |url-status=dead }}</ref> The club participated in the [[2023–24 Saudi Pro League|Pro League]], the [[2023–24 King Cup|King's Cup]], the [[2023–24 AFC Champions League|AFC Champions League]], the [[2023 Arab Club Champions Cup|Arab Club Champions Cup]], and the [[2023 Saudi Super Cup|Super Cup]].

The season covers the period from 1 July 2023 to 30 June 2024. Most importantly, on 27 May 2024, against [[Al-Ittihad Club (Jeddah)|Al-Ittihad]], Ronaldo scored his 34th and 35th league goals of the season, setting a record most goals scored in a single Saudi Pro League campaign. He also became the first footballer to finish as top scorer in four different leagues.<ref>{{cite web |last=Banerjee |first=Ritabrata |date=27 May 2024 |title=Cristiano Ronaldo makes history again! Al-Nassr hero breaks Saudi Pro League record for most goals in a season as Portugal hero downs Al-Ittihad |url=https://www.goal.com/en-kw/lists/cristiano-ronaldo-makes-history-al-nassr-breaks-saudi-pro-league-record-most-goals-in-season/bltdba00468162c54b2#csf3eebff5aaf5212a |access-date=11 June 2024 |publisher=Goal.com}}</ref>
